test_item_verbatim: From the AUX Cam settings menu, the user presses “Make Favorite”.

tcs.tc_title: pressing Make Favorite from the AUX Cam settings menu opens the confirmation
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. A wired AUX camera is connected
3. The wired camera is not currently a favorite
4. The individual AUX Cam settings pop-up for the wired camera is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the "Make Favorite" soft control
2. Read the HU display and check that a confirmation pop-up is displayed
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "Make Favorite" soft control registers the press
2. A confirmation pop-up is displayed
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.split_reason: pressing Make Favorite from the AUX Cam settings menu opens the confirmation
tcs.test_item:
From the AUX Cam settings menu, the user presses “Make Favorite”.

(pressing Make Favorite from the AUX Cam settings menu opens the confirmation)

reasoning: §30.1.2 為 §30.1 流程之第一步（其後 §30.1.3～§30.1.6 為後續各步）。與 `-139`（§30.1.1）之分工：後者為**能力陳述**（可經此入口設為最愛），本列為**流程之起點**（按下後出現確認彈窗）；兩列之來源列不同（**R-CAM10**）。確認彈窗之內容由 `-142`（§30.1.3）承接。
